title: Ek Truck Delhi Se Mumbai Gaya: Owner Ko Kitna Bachta Hai?
description: Reasoning: the sleeper bus reel (₹43,200 from one trip) shows our audience engages with fleet economics told through a single trip. Trucks are a classic 'buy a truck and earn' dream in small-town India, and diesel, tolls and freight rates are public enough to build a defensible model.
text:
FACT SHEET: ONE TRUCK ON DELHI–MUMBAI, THE TRIP AS A BILL
Topic: per-trip and monthly money for a truck owner. Figures are mostly 2026 online estimates from freight platforms. They are not official data and they vary by truck type, season and broker. Each cite tag below is followed by its source URL in brackets.

**HEADLINE CAVEAT FOR THE SCRIPTWRITER**
- I found no audited or official per-trip P&L for Delhi–Mumbai. Every trip bill below is a platform or blog estimate. Say "estimates" on screen.
- I found no sourced monthly-net figure for a 5-truck owner. See DATA GAPS at the end. Do not invent one.

**1. THE FREIGHT BILL (what the customer pays)**
- Distance is about 1,369 km on NH 48 via Jaipur, Udaipur and Vadodara. The road distance from Delhi to Mumbai is approximately 1,369 km [https://www.trukky.com/delhi-to-mumbai]
- Other sources use about 1,400 km, and one uses 1,420 km. [https://www.assureshift.in/blog/truck-transport-cost-km] [https://onroadcost.com/blog/diesel-price-increase-effect-truck-profit]
- 32ft container (16T), 15 tonnes loaded: indicative trip fare Rs.1,10,800 - Rs.1,20,700 [https://truckguru.co.in/blog/truck-transportation-cost-in-india/]
- 32ft container (7–8T), 8 tonnes loaded: indicative trip fare Rs.78,100 - Rs.82,400 [https://truckguru.co.in/blog/truck-transportation-cost-in-india/]
- 14ft Eicher (3.5 ton): Rs.43,400 - Rs.49,000 for the trip, toll included (checked October 2026) [https://truckguru.co.in/delhi-transport-services]
- 19ft truck, 5 km/L (worked example): freight received ₹48,000 [https://onroadcost.com/blog/diesel-price-increase-effect-truck-profit]
- 24-ft container (10–14 MT): ₹45,000–₹65,000 per trip. [https://ipgroup.co.in/delhi-to-mumbai-freight-transport/]
- Platform rate card for a 32ft multi-axle: ₹85 – ₹110 / km outstation. [https://mukundlogistic.com/daily-freight-rates/]
- Rates vary a lot by truck, season and broker. Delhi to Mumbai is one of the busiest lanes in the country, so trucks are usually easy to find outside October to December. [https://truckguru.co.in/delhi-transport-services]

**2. THE COST SIDE, LINE BY LINE (the "bill")**

Diesel (biggest line)
- Diesel is 40–50% of total cost. Diesel accounts for 40–50% of total truck transport cost [https://www.assureshift.in/blog/truck-transport-cost-km]
- Diesel price in 2026 is ₹88–₹95 per litre depending on the state. [https://www.assureshift.in/blog/truck-transport-cost-km]
- 32ft multi-axle mileage is about 5 km/L at ₹93/L, which is ₹19–24 per km. [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-transport-charges-in-india/]
- A 19ft truck at 5 km/L needs 284 litres for Delhi–Mumbai. [https://onroadcost.com/blog/diesel-price-increase-effect-truck-profit]
- That is ₹24,992 at ₹88/L and ₹26,128 at ₹92/L. [https://onroadcost.com/blog/diesel-price-increase-effect-truck-profit]
- Another platform estimate: 258 litres (@ 5.5 km/L) at a cost of ₹23,478 for a 19ft container. [https://mukundlogistic.com/daily-freight-rates/]
- Hills hurt mileage. Ghat sections halve fuel efficiency — 5 km/L on highway drops to 2.5 km/L [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-transport-charges-in-india/]
- Each ₹1 rise in diesel adds ₹200 per 1,000 km for a 19ft truck, ₹290 for a 32ft truck [https://onroadcost.com/blog/diesel-price-increase-effect-truck-profit]

Tolls (second-biggest running line). Estimates conflict widely, so show a range and say "sources differ."
- ₹3,479 FASTag for a 19ft container. [https://mukundlogistic.com/daily-freight-rates/]
- ₹4,500 in a broker-negotiation example. [https://onroadcost.com/blog/diesel-price-increase-effect-truck-profit]
- ₹5,000–₹8,500 for the full journey on a standard multi-axle vehicle. [https://ipgroup.co.in/delhi-to-mumbai-freight-transport/]
- Delhi–Mumbai toll alone is ₹8,000–12,000 per trip for a 16-tyre MXL. [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-transport-charges-in-india/]
- Rate cards for the Delhi–Mumbai Expressway section are per km. Bus/Truck (2-Axle) ₹7.50/km; Multi-Axle (3+ Axle) ₹9.50/km [https://brokersaathi.com/blogs/delhi-mumbai-expressway/]
- Per-plaza example: Sohna-Dausa stretch costs approximately ₹500 for light vehicles and ₹1,685 for heavy vehicles [https://infra.tractorjunction.com/en/news/delhi-mumbai-expressway-guide]
- Rates are revised. Toll rates rising by around 5% for most categories on the Vadodara–Bharuch section. [https://www.dnpindia.in/states/delhi-mumbai-expressway-travel-gets-costlier-as-nhai-raises-toll-rates-from-july-21/608308/]
- Per-km toll for a 16-tyre MXL: ₹3–7 per km. [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-transport-charges-in-india/]

Driver and helper
- Driver bata (trip allowance) is about ₹3,000 in FR8's worked example. driver bata ₹3,000 [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-transport-charges-in-india/]
- For a 3-day Delhi–Mumbai trip: driver wages alone add ₹2,400–₹3,600 [https://www.assureshift.in/blog/truck-transport-cost-km]
- Monthly driver pay, long-distance/interstate: ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-driver-salary-in-india-2023/]
- Indeed's average is lower, at ₹19,787 per month. In Delhi it is ₹27,526. [https://in.indeed.com/career/truck-driver/salaries]
- Driver plus cleaner together: ₹44,000–58,000 a month. [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-transport-charges-in-india/]
- Waiting is unpaid for the owner. A truck waiting 4–8 hours at a Mumbai or Bengaluru delivery point runs up driver bata and daily fixed costs without moving. [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-transport-charges-in-india/]

Tyres and maintenance
- Tyre wear + maintenance ₹3.5–5.5 per km. [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-transport-charges-in-india/]
- Another calculator allocates ₹2 to ₹4 per km. [https://www.truckbill.in/tools/cost-per-km-calculator.html]
- An older (about 2021) analysis found 10 tyres each costing ₹20,000 with a life span of 1,50,000 kms, around ₹1.33/km for tyres alone. [https://rana-ankit.medium.com/the-unit-economics-of-road-transport-in-india-3641bc63d16d]

EMI, insurance and permits (fixed costs, which run whether or not the truck moves)
- A 32ft multi-axle truck costs about ₹35 lakh all-in (₹25 lakh + taxes + body + modifications). [https://rana-ankit.medium.com/the-unit-economics-of-road-transport-in-india-3641bc63d16d]
- EMI for a ₹35L truck, 5-year loan at 10%: ₹55,000–65,000 a month. [https://www.fr8.in/blog/truck-transport-charges-in-india/]
